back_translation: "Hear this, O house of Jacob, you who are called by the name of Israel and have come from the waters of Judah, you who swear by the name of the LORD and invoke the God of Israel — but not in truth or righteousness.
For they call themselves after the holy city and lean on the God of Israel — the LORD of Hosts is His name.
I declared the former things long ago; they went out of My mouth and I proclaimed them. Then suddenly I acted, and they came to pass.
Because I knew that you are very stubborn — your neck is an iron sinew and your forehead is bronze —
therefore I told you long ago; before it happened I announced it to you, so that you could not say, 'My idol did these things; my carved image and cast image commanded them.'
You have heard; now see all this. Will you not acknowledge it? From now on I will let you hear new things, hidden things you have not known.
They are created now, not long ago; before today you never heard of them, so that you could not say, 'I already knew them.'
You never heard, you never knew; your ear has not been open from of old. For I knew that you are utterly treacherous; you have been called a rebel from birth.
For the sake of My name I will hold back My anger; for the sake of My praise I will restrain it for you, so as not to cut you off.
Behold, I have refined you, but not as silver is refined; I have tested you in the furnace of affliction.
For My own sake — for My own sake — I do this. For how can I let My name be profaned? I will not give My glory to another.
Listen to Me, O Jacob, and Israel whom I have called: I am He; I am the first, and I am also the last.
Surely My own hand founded the earth, and My right hand stretched out the heavens; when I call to them, they stand up together.
Assemble, all of you, and listen: which among the idols has declared these things? The one whom the LORD loves will carry out His pleasure against Babylon, and his arm will be against the Chaldeans.
I — I Myself — have spoken; yes, I have called him. I have brought him, and he will succeed in his mission.
Come near to Me and hear this: from the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time it came to be, I have been there." And now the Lord GOD has sent me, together with His Spirit.
Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "I am the LORD your God, who teaches you for your own benefit, who leads you in the way you should go.
Oh, if only you had paid attention to My commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness like the waves of the sea.
Your offspring would have been as numerous as the sand, and the descendants of your body like its countless grains. Their name would never be cut off or destroyed from before Me."
Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! Announce it with a shout of joy; proclaim it; send this news out to the ends of the earth: "The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob!"
They did not thirst when He led them through the deserts; He made water flow from the rock for them; He split the rock, and water gushed out.
"There is no peace," says the LORD, "for the wicked."
